title: Beetroot: modeled ₹944/qtl left, Neyyatinkara → Thrippunithura
summary: January 2021: reported beetroot prices at Neyyatinkara and Thrippunithura imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 91% of 22 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹944 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 186 same-variety market pairs screened for beetroot in January 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Thrippunithura report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2021
scenes.caption: Neyyatinkara (Kerala) and Thrippunithura (Kerala) both reported beetroot prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 22 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Neyyatinkara reported a median ₹3,400 per quintal. Thrippunithura reported a median ₹4,500 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,300/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,300 per quintal, and Thrippunithura was dearer on 91% of days.

scenes.headline: 225 km by road
scenes.caption: 225 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~4 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹48/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹797 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹533 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Thrippunithura report, the rule selects 16 of 20 modeled shipping days. 15 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹944 per quintal (₹710 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Beetroot route from Neyyatinkara to Thrippunithura was positive on 91% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹94,400, or ₹71,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹48/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Beetroot route from Neyyatinkara to Thrippunithura was positive on 91% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹94,400, or ₹71,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

title: Beetroot: modeled ₹585/qtl left, Kayamkulam → Aroor
summary: October 2021: reported beetroot prices at Kayamkulam and Aroor imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 96% of 26 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹585 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 152 same-variety market pairs screened for beetroot in October 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Aroor report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: October 2021
scenes.caption: Kayamkulam (Kerala) and Aroor (Kerala) both reported beetroot prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 26 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kayamkulam reported a median ₹2,300 per quintal. Aroor reported a median ₹3,100 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹900/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹900 per quintal, and Aroor was dearer on 96% of days.

scenes.headline: 91 km by road
scenes.caption: 91 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹20/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹600 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹439 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Aroor report, the rule selects 24 of 26 modeled shipping days. 23 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹585 per quintal (₹423 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Beetroot route from Kayamkulam to Aroor was positive on 96% of matched days in October 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹58,500, or ₹42,300 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to beetroot
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹20/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Beetroot route from Kayamkulam to Aroor was positive on 96% of matched days in October 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹58,500, or ₹42,300 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
